about.assistcoach_unterstutzt_trai: AssistCoach supports coaches and officials in youth sport – whether football, volleyball or tennis. At the same time, we want to create a place where the collective knowledge of many comes together, so that we can all grow together and give our athletes even better training.
about.lass_dich_von_einer_vielzahl: Get inspired by a wide range of exercises, plan your sessions ahead and keep track of content and intensity. Prepare training so that it runs smoothly even without you – ideal when someone else needs to take over.
about.lerne_wie_du_einen_klaren_au: Learn how to give every session a clear structure and a common thread. Discover new exercises and use filters when you are looking for ideas on a topic – no matter how little experience you have.
about.plane_dein_training_deine_wo: Plan your training, your week or the whole season – whether pre-season or a double match load. Keep track of intensity, training days and which players are used in which exercises. Customise every session completely or get inspired – and make sure everything goes to plan, even when you are not there yourself.
about.verliere_nie_wieder_den_uber: Never lose track of equipment, scheduling and load distribution again. See at a glance how long each exercise lasts and how the intensity is distributed across your session. A more professional preparation in less time – so more time and real interaction remain on the pitch.
